meta.title: Privacy Policy
meta.description: How EdgeRize collects, uses and protects your data.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data we collect when you use our site and services, how we use it, and your rights.

sections.heading: Data we collect
sections.body: We collect data you provide (e.g. your name, email and message via the contact form) and basic technical data about your visit (with your consent for analytics).

sections.heading: How we use data
sections.body: We use data to respond to your enquiries, provide and improve our services and, with consent, understand how the site is used. We do not sell your data.

sections.heading: Cookies and analytics
sections.body: We set analytics cookies (Google Analytics) only after you consent. See our Cookie Policy for details.

sections.heading: Sharing with third parties
sections.body: We share data only with trusted processors who help us operate (e.g. email and analytics), and only as necessary to provide the service.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, delete and object to the processing of your data, in line with applicable data protection law. To exercise these rights, contact us.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any privacy questions, write to us at office@edgerize.rs.

privacy.disclaimer: This document is for information only and does not constitute legal advice.

meta.title: Terms of Service
meta.description: The terms under which you use the EdgeRize site and services.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using this site and services you accept these terms. If you do not agree with them, please do not use the site.

sections.heading: Use of the services
sections.body: You may use the services in accordance with the law and these terms. We reserve the right to restrict access in case of misuse.

sections.heading: Accounts
sections.body: If you create an account, you are responsible for keeping your credentials safe and for activity on your account.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
sections.body: EdgeRize, its content and brand are our property and protected by applicable rights. Your content remains yours.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: We provide the services "as is". To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of the services.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after changes means you accept the new terms.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For questions about these terms, write to us at office@edgerize.rs.

terms.disclaimer: This document is for information only and does not constitute legal advice.

meta.title: Cookie Policy
meta.description: Which cookies EdgeRize uses and how to manage them.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: Cookies are small files a site stores on your device. We use them to make the site work and, with your consent, to understand how it's used.

sections.heading: Essential cookies
sections.body: These enable core site functions, like remembering your language and theme choice. They are always active.

sections.heading: Analytics cookies
sections.body: Google Analytics helps us understand visits and improve the site. We set them only after you consent.

sections.heading: Managing cookies
sections.body: You can change your consent at any time via the cookie settings on the site, as well as in your browser settings.

cookies.disclaimer: This document is for information only and does not constitute legal advice.
